BP Appoints New Chair Amid Boardroom Changes

Oil giant BP has appointed a new chairman, signaling an end to a period of boardroom upheaval. The company sought a chair to help navigate its strategic direction. The appointment follows a search process aimed at stabilizing leadership after recent changes. The new chair is expected to guide BP through its ongoing energy transition and business strategy.
